'''Lyran bloodslugs''' were [[Diet/Legends|omnivorous]] [[Parasite/Legends|parasites]] native to [[Lyran IV]]. Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], bloodslugs were exported to [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]], causing the [[Death/Legends|death]] of over 100 individuals.<ref name="Wizards" />

The bloodslugs were commonly used by [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] to carry out revenge on [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] or traders by releasing the slugs into the supply of [[Grain/Legends|grain]] carried by their ship. The slugs fattened themselves up until they had a chance to seek out the ship's pilot and burrow into their skin. After the host was slowly drained of blood by the slugs, they would eventually die.<ref name="Wizards" />
